name: check_class_availability
description: Look up available classes for the requested day. Omit the class name when the caller is open to any class. Use before collecting or saving a class request.

class_name.description: Class name or the caller's alias, such as spin

class_date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD or an unambiguous expression such as tomorrow

class_time.description: Local start time including AM or PM if known

name: submit_booking_request
description: Save a pending fictional demo class request or inquiry for staff. Use only after the caller explicitly confirms the request details. This cannot confirm a booking.

caller_phone.description: Fictional callback number supplied for the demo

class_id.description: Exact ID returned by the availability tool. Omit for a question-only inquiry.

questions_asked.description: Question the caller asked staff to follow up on. Omit for a class-only request.

call_summary.description: One sentence summarizing the confirmed demo request, without other personal details
